title: Nuova PSC
description: nuovapsc.it 300GB Nuova PSC is an Italian engineering firm in Milan, continuation of Gruppo PSC, founded after WWII by Emidio Pesce and once a leader in technological systems for major works, which collapsed under 400 million euros of debt and entered concordato preventivo in 2022. Fund Nextalia acquired the group in 2024 and split it: Nuova PSC and Atisa sold to construction consortium Conpat on 25 July 2024, energy to Arcipelago, telecoms unit Italtel to Digital Value. Nuova PSC runs five business units, fire protection, naval, MEP, energy and public tenders, backed by 60 plus years of know how, ISO 9001, 14001, 45001, 50001, SA8000 and SOA class VIII for unlimited public contracts. Key customer is shipbuilder Fincantieri, with fire and water mist systems on cruise ships and Italian Navy vessels at Marghera, Monfalcone and Genoa yards. Offices in Rome, Milan, Ancona, Genoa and Copenhagen, revenue around 35 to 63 million euro, headcount up 126 percent.
